camerad.author: bluseliu50
modifications: Use writable CCM payload for V4L2 S_EXT_CTRLS copy-back; retain the upstream matrix values.
Check rear flip controls and ACTIVE format readback; log sensor/PHY contract before STREAMON without retrying or changing upstream modes.
Publish NV12 by default with the Mesa Turnip gen8 texture line-offset fix; retain PIANO_CAMERA_OUTPUT=bgrx as an optional compatibility conversion.
Use an AArch64 NEON NV12-to-BGRx path with exact Q8 scalar equivalence, scalar tails and a non-AArch64 scalar fallback.
Rear analogue gain unit 32 (1x), matching the S5KJN1 driver's raw gain code with 1/32x steps.

firmware: The imported CAMSS TFE pixel path and sensors make no request_firmware calls; no additional camera firmware payload.
